mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy cycle, lowering discount rates applied to equity cash flows and boosting future stock valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When GDPC1 crosses above 11,450 billion chained 2017 dollars, indicating robust demand, corporate earnings growth accelerates, driving up S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 crosses above 11,450 billion chained 2017 dollars in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite GDPC1 crossing above 11,450 billion chained 2017 dollars.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tight labor market, enhancing productivity and corporate profitability, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases >2% and UNRATE decreases >0.1pp in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS increases >2% and UNRATE decreases >0.1pp in the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the INDPRO index above 113 signals stronger production capacity, boosting corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite INDPRO crossing above 113.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), elevated interest rates compress equity valuations, reducing future cash flow discounting and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during a monetary tightening cycle when FEDFUNDS rises >0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in gross domestic product demand (GDPC1) and industrial production (RSAFS) indicate strong economic momentum, amplifying corporate profits and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and RSAFS both increase >5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite both GDPC1 and RSAFS increasing >5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% reflects a healthier labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE falls below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the INDPRO index falls below 110, signaling weakening production capacity, corporate earnings growth slows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) despite INDPRO falling below 110.
